notes.title: Patch v1.6.1
notes.notes:
Hello. Anyone still here? Just a real quick patch to fix one major issue a hero reported.

[b]Here's what's new in v1.6.1[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixing a rare game breaking bug that could occur if you had the worst luck in the world, and you happened to enable the "Disable Cursive" option in the Accessibility settings while in the middle of a typing session
[*] Removing a lot of weird and confusing abbreviations specifically for North Charleston. (NO CHAS)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.6
notes.notes:
Thank you Data Conversion Operators for your valuable bug reports, feedback, and reviews.

[b]Here's what's new in v1.6:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixing a bug where if you Saved and Quit with a very specific timing (right after starting your workday at the computer), if you then- from the Titlescreen- immediately loaded the Save it would put the game into such a w e i r d and cursed state that it even freaked ME out with how suddenly foreign and unreliable certain things now became... somehow while still kinda 'functioning'? As fun as this was though, it could easily soft lock the game (and possibly kill your playthrough)
[*] Patched a bug where you could possibly phase through the locked fence in the stairwell, and your reward was prematurely being locked away forever in a dark descending abyss
[*] Fixing an annoying bug where if you exited the Pause screen while standing in front of something interactable, it would be interacted with
[*] Fixed some unintended lighting oddities that could occur in the apartment
[*] Fixed an edge case bug where key in the Key Rebinding screen in Settings could eventually forget its default bindings if you reset it with the Backspace key several times, whoops
[*]Fixed misc UI timing bugs 
[*] Key Rebinding screen will now alert you if you've bound the same key to multiple actions
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.5.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixing an issue where if you saw the  W▀░▒░▐,░N ending a 2nd time, a portion of it would be super dark
[*] Fixing some typos. "It's" is a villain.
[*] Fixing an issue that would prevent ░▐  ░▒░▐ from appearing
[*] Fixing insanely rare but technically achievable collision issue in the final section
[*] Fixed bug with the content warning not showing correctly for first time launch
[*] Some optimizations and memory reduction improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.5 [Linux Users Please Read]
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Hot fixing a [b]critical issue[/b] preventing native Linux build from launching correctly if you have updated glibc to v2.41 (which apparently broke a lot of backwards compatibility, and fun fact was released the same day as DEAD LETTER DEPT.) [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1627350/discussions/1/600770015625540643/]Steam Forum thread about it here.[/url]
[*] Cloud syncing on Linux should now fully function correctly
[*] Fixing a rare edgecase issue where entering a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tab_key#Tab_characters]Vertical Tab[/url] (somehow) in a very very specific circumstance could somehow cause the save data to get corrupted and ultimately reset itself. Also, I learned that Vertical Tabs are apparently a thing, but how you enter one in 2025 is a complete mystery to me (chime in if you're familiar with using these in the modern age).
[*] Adding an error screen on launch to notify you if the Save Data is corrupted/not loadable, which will give you some options to consider. Mainly added this to catch any other weird circumstances after encountering the crazy Vertical Tab thing. If I'm very lucky nobody will ever see it.
[*] Fixing the Recommended Controller layout for SteamDeck not showing up correctly
[*] Fixing minor bug where the Display Resolution setting would get confused and show the wrong entry
[*] Several other minor polish & fixes
[/list]

Thank you very much for your reviews and your bug reports.

notes.title: Release Less Than 2 Weeks Away - Linux + SteamOS Version Announced ??
notes.notes:
[b][h2]DEAD LETTER DEPT. ARRIVING JANUARY 30TH FOR 
WINDOWS + LINUX / STEAM OS[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520437/533d1c33c54119f6474375d9ab24ffa4ec44ef98.png[/img]

It's a long story really. What began as a casual investigation into making sure the game functionally runs on Steam Deck, turned into: '[i]Oh, the game appears to run surprisingly well on Linux???[/i]' Frankly I anticipated random filesystem explosions and graphical razorblades to have to solve for this, like with any port. But nope? It's been tested on 4 different distros (Zorin, Arch, Ubuntu, and the SteamOS of course) and appears to run pretty identical to its Windows counterpart. So I think that's cautiously optimistic enough results to try.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627350/Dead_Letter_Dept/

Frankly making a Linux version automatically solves a [b][i]MASSIVE  GAMEBREAKING VIDEO CODEC[/i][/b]  issue if the game would be run under Proton (on the Steam Deck), so I might as just publish a Linux version.

I realize the Linux user demand for this game isn't necessarily huge (to be fair I haven't listed it as Linux supported yet either), but I'm willing to give it a fair shot. Linux fascinates and terrifies.

notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCED
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=p7KFd_WxOlM;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been a strange & difficult path but it is with great pleasure I'm able to announce DEAD LETTER DEPT. is finally going to be arriving on STEAM, this month on January 30th.

[i]Taking a temp job while you get situated in a new city, you are tasked with data-entry-like work of typing up the words and addresses on mail & letters that were not deliverable- due to bad handwriting or other odd reasons. As the days pass, strange stories begin to emerge from the mail, you can't ever shake this feeling you're being watched.

Working in a dingy warehouse, isolated from anyone and everyone, your only connection to the outside world are glimpses of letters that couldn't reach their destination. As time goes on, working conditions become questionable and dreamlike. Oddities and cracks begin to appear. Making money for rent is important, but at what cost.[/i]

Please do me a favor if you can and do share DEAD LETTER DEPT. around, whether it be the [url=https://youtu.be/sIyIh7-1P7o]TRAILER[/url] or the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627350/Dead_Letter_Dept/]STEAM PAGE[/url]. And if you are media/a creator and need assets, please check out the [url=https://www.beliefengine.com/presskit/deadletterdept/]presskit[/url] and reach out if you need anything.

-Mike
